description: This file provides image compression utilities, including a class for handling files with URIs, functions for compressing images, drawing images onto canvases with resizing and rotation, and size adjustment helpers.

classes.name: FileWithURI
classes.description: A subclass of File that includes a URI property created from the file.

methods.name: compressImage
methods.description: Compresses an image file based on provided options, returning a Blob of the compressed image.

methods.name: getAdjustedSizes
methods.description: Calculates the maximum or minimum sizes for an image under a given aspect ratio and resize mode.
